answer: RIDGE-WALK QUORUM: each close picks K countersigners by a seeded random wander over the attestation graph. The close-root tide drives the wander to K peers you have actually attested, so a stranger cannot buy a seat. Every walker stakes a bond equal to its ridge - the depth of its longest unbroken attestation chain. A sybil farm must run K identities with months of real uptime, or forge a live agent's ridge history and get it burned at the close. Attacker cost: K months of uptime or a burned forgery.
